# PICSELL

> PICSELL is a Ukrainian retail-execution platform for FMCG manufacturers and distributors: Vision AI shelf recognition, Sales Force Automation (SFA) for field teams, HoReCa Intelligence and competitive market monitoring — one mobile app for every field role plus web analytics. Site in Ukrainian (https://picsell.ai/) and English (https://picsell.ai/en/). Part of Imperia Holding, Kyiv, Ukraine.

Key facts:
- Who it is for: FMCG brands (manufacturers) and distributors running merchandisers, sales reps and supervisors in retail stores and HoReCa (restaurants, bars, cafés).
- What it does: GPS-verified routes and visits, tasks with photo reports, Store Check and Perfect Store, assortment matrices, price monitoring, orders, KPI tracking, offline-first mobile app; Vision AI recognises products on shelf photos (out-of-stock, share of shelf, planogram compliance) in about 60 seconds per audit.
- Trust and control: a visit starts only within the outlet's GPS radius and spoofed GPS is flagged; every photo from the in-app camera is watermarked with outlet, date and time; supervisors approve or reject photos and a rejection creates a corrective task.
- Also in the platform: team chats inside PICSELL, a planogram builder with plan-vs-fact checks in every visit, and monthly sales planning (target, actuals from the accounting system, required daily pace).
- Try before a demo: email 20 photos of your shelves to info@picsell.ai and the team shows what PICSELL Vision recognises on them.
- Clients include Lactalis, Henkel, Schwarzkopf, Diageo, Colgate, Bayadera, Masafi and IDS Borjomi (see the Lactalis case study).
- Pricing (per user per month, UAH; final price agreed individually): merchandiser ₴1,400, sales rep ₴1,400, supervisor ₴1,000, other user ₴900. Radar and HoReCa add-ons from ₴20,000. Calculator: https://picsell.ai/en/calculator/
- Contacts: sales +380 77 880 98 88, support +380 67 363 06 44, info@picsell.ai. Free demo on request: https://picsell.ai/en/demo/

## Product
- [Core — field execution foundation](https://picsell.ai/en/core/): routes and visits with GPS, photo-report tasks, Store Check, Perfect Store, assortment and price monitoring, merch planning
- [Vision AI — shelf recognition](https://picsell.ai/en/vision-ai/): OOS detection, share of shelf, planogram compliance
- [SFA — field sales app](https://picsell.ai/en/sales-app/): route planning, orders, visit control, KPIs for sales reps
- [HoReCa — menu analytics](https://picsell.ai/en/horeca/): collects venue menus and bar lists (website, PDF, photo), recognises every item and cocktail with AI, marks each as the client's brand or a competitor by the client's SKU directory, and shows share of menu, position in the section, prices, a coverage map by region and a venue base imported from Google Places (with rating and review count). For drinks brands and distributors. From ₴20,000 a month; free audit of 50 venues at the demo.
- [Digital Shelf — price monitoring](https://picsell.ai/en/radar/): daily collection of price, discounted price and availability from 27 Ukrainian online stores (Rozetka, Epicentr, Maudau, MakeUp, Notino, Silpo, ATB, Varus, Fora, Fozzy, Metro, Zakaz.ua, MegaMarket, Auchan, Tavria V, Kopiyka, Rukavychka; alcohol: Bayadera, OkWine, WineTime, GoodWine, WinePoint, VintageMarket, AlcoMag, RumkaOnline, WineWine, WineWorld); RRP with validity dates and history; promotions of 7 chains; assortment changes in categories of Silpo, Varus, MegaMarket and Zakaz.ua; wholesale prices (Metro, Fozzy), promo-code price (Notino), EU-delivery variant (MakeUp); full history; reports in Power BI. From ₴20,000 a month.
- [Analytics](https://picsell.ai/en/analytics/): BI dashboards, Perfect Store score, distributor KPIs
- [Integrations](https://picsell.ai/en/integrations/): two-way exchange with 1C, BAS, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or your own ERP through an open API (Swagger docs); products, prices, stock, accounts, debts and payments in, orders and returns back; Power BI reports; .csv/.xlsx import
